text:
maria.sales: Connection with NovaBank today. They're asking for an explicit "no-export" guarantee, monthly rotation driven by their HSM, and evidence of our audit logging being forwarded to their Splunk. Also want to schedule a pen-test in the POC window. Can we confirm our stance?

dan.engineering: We do not ever export key material from a certified HSM. We can produce attestation certs and signed nonces at rotation. The integration supports customer-initiated rotation via our key mapping API; expect negligible downtime. For Splunk forwarding, we can push signed audit snapshots (S3 or HTTPS) they can ingest.

sara.security: We require the customer to provide attestation verification steps; we'll validate chain. For "no-export" we can provide firmware+policy proof and HSM vendor docs. Pen test: allowed on staging only; must sign the pentest agreement.

leo.sre: Ops note: require staging IP whitelisting, and a 1-hour maintenance window during the production cutover. Recommend a staged traffic shift and can provide synthetic tests for TPS verification.

kate.solutions: Pricing: BYO-HSM POC = +18% POC surcharge. Forwarding signed audit snapshots to customer's Splunk may have a small log-transfer fee if we keep retention beyond 30 days.

maria.sales: Great. I'll confirm the evidence bundle we'll send: attestation certs, vendor docs, signed audit snapshots, and our pentest policy.

redwood-bot: Document uploaded: NOVABANK_POC_EVIDENCE_BUNDLE.zip

maria.sales: I'll draft the security questionnaire reply and loop in legal for the pentest NDA.
